limits: Geometry and logical connectivity validated; whole-board routing remains incomplete.
Centerline length audit omits travel within pads and is not an electromagnetic simulation.
Every listed via-in-pad requires filled and copper-capped fabrication.
Any later copper or placement changes require native DRC, path analysis, and filled-reference audit again.
Native refill and connectivity check must verify that every GND patch joins In1 through the placed return vias.
The1.5mm return-via distance is a design target, not a standards-derived limit.
Final full-board field/USB compliance validation remains necessary.

fabrication.process: POFV: resin-filled, planarized, copper-capped through vias at every flagged location
